title: Naidu and Pawan Kalyan promise to transform Udayagiri into industrial and tourism hub
description: Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu assures to resolve the drinking water issues in Oletivari Palem, Gudur, and Lingasamudram mandals through the Rallapadu Reservoir; says ₹100 crore will be sanctioned to provide safe drinking water to 189 fluoride-affected villages
